jobPostingInfo.title: Developer, RBC Amplify 2027, Toronto
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription: You will be expected to research, design, create and deliver a fully functional prototype to RBC that solves a real business need. Must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary institution, graduating between August 2027 and June 2028 (College, Undergrad, Master's or PhD). Understanding of programming languages, databases, platforms, frameworks, design techniques and tools, code management tooling, and/or web technologies. Experience with service-based architectures and API development (Rest, GraphQL, etc.) Job Type: Student/Coop (Fixed Term)
